method: Read-only source/procedure/artifact comparison, cryptographic file hashing, safe structured assertions and inspection of three captured UI screenshots. No browser, SDK parsing, network, service or transaction execution.

functionalAssessment.bookmark: Canonical revision 0 action adds target post to Bookmarks.
functionalAssessment.follow: Canonical revision 1 follows the subboard; Following includes both target post and existing anonymous reply. Named-identity following is not exercised.
functionalAssessment.subscribe: Canonical revision 2 subscribes to thread and displays existing anonymous reply 688 in Notifications.
functionalAssessment.readMarker: Canonical revision 3 marks through block 688 and removes the existing reply from Notifications while Following remains populated.
functionalAssessment.persistence: Same authoritative profile reopened in a new browser context, authenticated application recovery completed, seven encrypted journal envelopes retained, exact last confirmed workflow and signed-byte digest unchanged; zero application-page sends. This is not fresh keys-only restoration.

evidenceChecks: All 69 packet references and three phase-specific procedure bindings match exact size/SHA256.
Four exclusive durable intent files correlate exact runtime/source/action IDs to confirmed workflows; nonces/actions retained; revisions observed 0,1,2,3.
One aztec_sendTx request per mutation; exact prior confirmed signed journal chained across phases; fees below explicit prepared maximum and overall cap.

All canonical records agree with receipt/effect hashes; source-inspected observer checks typed Tx hash, fee, receipt, full binary effect, unique inclusion in block and fresh block hash before event decoding.
All six successful phase supervisors show closed owned trees; final counters zero blocked/inspection errors and retained original backup hash unchanged.
Encrypted envelope structure matches source AES-GCM/AAD journal implementation; local private-view selection consumes authenticated completed preferences and ordinary public feed pages.
Captured screenshots independently show subscribed reply, reopened bookmarked post with Unsubscribe control, and empty reopened Notifications.

privacyAssessment.supported: Source selects private views locally from ordinary public feed pages; encrypted cached preferences use authenticated journal storage. Four actual decoded board event arrays are empty. No public plaintext preference relationship event observed in this scoped decoder.
privacyAssessment.traceLimitation: Final two phases summarize only allowlisted query-key names; unknown keys are silently filtered out, paths outside fixed list become other, and POST body/headers/remote ingress are not fully captured. Therefore these summaries cannot establish absence of public/backend relationship disclosure.
privacyAssessment.trustedBoundary: UI explicitly discloses configured trusted prover/query service visibility. Full node/archive containment, timing/content linkage and specialist privacy gates remain unchanged.
privacyAssessment.wireReview: Exact wire/effect file hashes verified and actual source observer binding inspected. Reviewer did not independently reparse signed wire or decrypt journals, nor perform full protocol/public-effect leakage analysis.

preservedFailure.interpretation: Failed read-only attempt retained; separate awake run succeeded. No claim independently diagnosing host sleep from this packet alone.

limitations: Native/PXE proofs disabled; receipt status proven is a development-chain status, not real-proof qualification.
No fresh full-history keys-only <=120s recovery or WAN performance acceptance; private procedure used 180s action / 210s supervisor budgets.
Does not exercise unbookmark, unfollow, unsubscribe, followed-name behavior, new later reply arrival after marker, reorg, cross-account privacy or multi-device restoration.
Page-route counters exclude direct node canonical observer reads and do not establish extension-wide traffic or full proof-submission absence.
The seven encrypted records are retained private evidence, not a newly verified portable backup.
No model, funding, testnet, production release or complete RC25/RC26 closure claim.
followUp: Retain the scoped functional pass and privacy evidence limitation; no repeat of these paid actions is needed.
